verdict.rationale: Docs confirm some free actions (code-view edits don't use tokens), a mechanism to buy more tokens, and automatic model routing to balance quality/cost, giving founders a rough sense of what consumes tokens. However there's no detailed breakdown of how many tokens each specific action (e.g., a chat prompt, a fix, a deploy) costs, nor clear plan-tier token allotments, and community reports (e.g., 10M tokens burned on unneeded fixes, free tokens running out mid-build) show real-world consumption is unpredictable and not well explained upfront. Missing for 10: per-action token cost transparency, plan-tier quota tables, and independent confirmation that founders can reliably predict usage before it happens.
